blanket: A fog blanket hid the channel until noon.
blast: The horn blast echoes across the basin.
bleed: Bleed the trailer brakes before the long tow.
长途拖运前先排空拖车刹车气。
blend: The chandlery blends rope tar by hand.
船舶用品店手工调配绳用焦油。
bless: May the lock never fail; we bless it every equinox.
愿船闸永不失效，每次春分我们都为它祈福。
blessing: The new quay was a blessing for the oyster fleet.
新码头是牡蛎船队的福分。
blind: The bend after the bridge is a blind one.
桥后的弯道完全挡视线。
block: A stranded barge blocks the narrow channel.
一艘搁浅驳船堵住了窄航道。
blog: The keeper writes a weather blog daily.
看守人每天写天气博客。
blond: The young pilot has blond hair and steady hands.
年轻引航员金发而手稳。
